what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Cuba in Uruguay: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 23713 Cuban asylum seekers in Uruguay, 8.2% of all asylum seekers from Cuba.
Refugees from Cuba, a separate group, live mostly in Mexico and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Cuba, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2019 and 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2006 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 23825, at the end of 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Uruguay.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Uruguay only.
